# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul’s closing words to the Corinthians aren't a gentle suggestion; they are a battle cry. He lists four imperatives that demand action: Watch, Stand, Be Brave, Be Strong. As men, we are often tempted to either sleepwalk through our day or charge ahead in our own strength. But the warrior’s way is different. We are called to be vigilant against the enemy’s schemes, to refuse to be shaken by circumstances, and to anchor ourselves in the truth of the Gospel. True strength isn't found in flexing your own muscles; it is found in the discipline of standing firm on the Rock. When your foundation is solid, the storms of life—financial pressure, family conflict, or temptation—may rage, but they will not move you. You are not called to be passive; you are called to hold the line for your family and your faith. Check your posture today. Are you standing, or are you slouching? The battle requires men who are awake, brave, and unshakable.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups today. With every rep, pray, “Lord, make me watchful and unshakable in Your truth.”
